summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Tips Sharing: Clothing Details Edition ## Introduction In this video, we will explore tips on handling issues with clothing and model overlays in Marvelous Designer, specifically focusing on the use of false needle threads. ## Creating a Template First, use a rectangular tool to click on the 2D window to create a template. Long press the W key, then click on the template in the 3D window to add a fixed needle. ## Basic Use of the Sewing Tool I will introduce the basic use of the sewing tool for everyone. Select the sewing tool in the tool bar in the 3D window. You can click on two points on the template in the 3D window to create a false needle. ### Observing the False Needle After simulation, we can notice that the two points of the added false needle are sewn together. We can observe the false needle thread in the 2D window. After selecting the false needle thread, we can adjust its length in the attribute editor. The false needle thread in the 3D window will change to the length of the set value. ## Specific Use of the False Needle Thread Next, I will introduce the specific use of the false needle thread through a few cases. For this purpose, I prepared a hat file in advance. ### Adding a False Needle to a Hat Select the false needle tool and add a false needle on both sides of the hat. In addition to adding a false needle in the 3D window, we can also add one in the 2D window. Since the length of the false needle has not yet been adjusted, the two sides of the hat will be sewn together automatically. ### Adjusting the Length of the False Needle Thread After selecting the false needle thread, set the length for it. When setting the length, if the false needle thread is on the same piece of sheet, the length is absolute. If it is on two pieces of sheet, please refer to the specific length in the 3D window to adjust. ### Visual Changes in the 3D Window After reducing the length of the false needle thread, you will see that the two sides of the hat will be pulled up. If the length of the false needle thread is constantly shortened, the part where the false needle is added will be gathered. If the length is too short, the area will be pulled together. ## Editing the False Needle Thread We can edit the false needle thread in both the 2D and 3D windows. However, when moving the false needle thread in the 3D window, be cautious as it may get absorbed on the top plate of the camera angle. Therefore, in some cases, it is more accurate to adjust the false needle thread in the 2D window. ## Fixing the False Needle Thread to the Virtual Model In addition to the false needle thread tool, there are tools for fixing it to the virtual model. Fixing it to the virtual model ensures that the false needle thread is secured to the model at one end, preventing the plate from easily falling down. Click on the false needle thread on the clothing creation panel. If the clothing becomes transparent, it indicates that the creation is successful. ### Adjusting the Model and Clothing You can start clicking on the false needle thread on the model. You can use the false needle thread in the 3D window to adjust the model and the false needle thread on the clothing. However, if you use the fixed to the virtual model option, it is not possible to adjust the false needle thread position in the 2D window. ### Setting Length Between Model and Clothing We can also set the length of the false needle thread between the virtual model and the clothing. ## Second Case: Collar Adjustment Next is the second small case. We can notice that there is a bend in the collar. Use the false needle thread on the clothing to fix it to the bent part. If the collar is bent, we need to use the edited sewing tool to adjust the position of the false needle thread for a more natural appearance. ### Adjusting the Bottom of the Clothing Initially, the false needle thread may not be fixed firmly on the clothing. You can check the position at the bottom of the clothing and adjust it accordingly. ## Using the Sewing Machine In addition to separating manually, the edited sewing tool can also be utilized alongside a sewing machine to set the length and hold the two sides together. If the current length is too long, it needs to be shortened for a more natural look. ### Tightening the Clothing You can tighten the clothing by adding seams on both sides and setting the seam line length again. Use the sewing machine to fix the seam line on the left side, and adjust the position of the seam line, ensuring to save 1 cm of sewing allowance. ## Final Case: Skirt Adjustment For the final case, we will use the fixed tool on the virtual model to add a seam at the bottom of the skirt, then click on the virtual model's finger to add a seam. To prevent the waistband from being affected, freeze that part first. ### Shortening the Seam Length Use the edited seam tool to click on the seam line, continually shortening its length to avoid excessive shrinkage that could cause instability in the clothing. After adjusting one side, you can use the same method to lift the other side. ### Testing the Fabric Stability We can test what happens if we shrink the clothing all at once. The skirt may be easily pulled and deformed, resulting in instability. Therefore, it is advisable to use previous methods to adjust parts of the skirt for better stability. ## Conclusion After making adjustments, import the previously created pose file or use the same model as a Morph Target to change the model's pose. We can see how the skirt model appears with the changes applied. The form of the edited seam will also change with the model's pose. Finally, adjust the seam position to resolve any intersections between the clothing and the fingers. Thank you for watching! ```
